title: Oslo peace process dinner: Clinton presses Arafat to take the deal; first impression of Putin

tellings.quote: And he says to Arafat, "Take the deal, Yasser. Take the deal. It's your last best chance for peace."

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former officer of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says he was at a dinner at the royal castle in Oslo, Norway, around 1998, held as part of the Middle East peace talks. He says US President Bill Clinton urged the Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat, "Take the deal, Yasser. It's your last best chance for peace," with Israeli leader Ehud Barak there, and that this was also where he got his first impression of Vladimir Putin. He tells it as a first-hand look at a moment when history could have turned.
